entries.title: Psalms 25:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Teach - Teach me my duty, and cause me to keep close to it, notwithstanding all temptations.

entries.title: Psalms 25:8
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Upright - Holy and true, in all his declarations and offers of mercy to sinners. Therefore - He will not be wanting to such poor sinners as I am, but will guide them into the way of life and peace.

entries.title: Psalms 25:9
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The meek - Such as meekly submit themselves to God, and are desirous to be directed and governed by him. Judgment - In the paths of judgment, in the right way.

entries.title: Psalms 25:10
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Paths - All the dealings of God with them, yea even those that are afflictive, are done in kindness and faithfulness to them.

entries.title: Psalms 25:11
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: For - Or, though (as this particle is often rendered) it be great. Possibly he speaks of his sin against Uriah and Bathsheba. Great - Or, much or manifold. For the Hebrew word signifies both great and much.

entries.title: Psalms 25:13
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: At ease - Heb. in Good; in the possession and enjoyment of the true good. The land - Canaan; which was given as an earnest of the whole Covenant of Grace, and all its promises.

entries.title: Psalms 25:14
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The secret - His love and favour, which is called his secret, Job 29:4 Prov 3:32, because it is known to none but him that enjoyeth it. Will shew - He will make them clearly to understand it, both its duties and its blessings; neither of which ungodly men rightly understand.

entries.title: Psalms 25:15
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Pluck - He will deliver me out of all my troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 25:22
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Israel - If thou wilt not help me, yet spare thy people who suffer for my sake, and in my sufferings.
